title: Honey and Almond Cake
subtitle: Light almond sponge sweetened with honey
excerpt: A moist, golden cake made with ground almonds and honey instead of refined sugar. It keeps well for several days and gets better as the honey flavour deepens.
sourceNotes: Based on classic European nut cakes using ground almonds for a naturally moist crumb sweetened with honey.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the un-iced cake, well wrapped, for up to 2 months. Thaw at room temperature.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Bake a day ahead. The cake improves overnight as the honey settles into the crumb.

content.text: Use a deep-sided 20cm round tin lined with baking paper. The cake is dense so test it with a skewer at 40 minutes.

items.prepNote: ground to a fine meal in a food processor

content.text: Heat the oven to 170C (150C fan). Grease and line a 20cm round cake tin.
Beat the softened butter and honey together in a bowl until pale and creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each one.
Fold in the flour and ground almonds. Add the milk and stir until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin. Level the top. Scatter the flaked almonds over.
Bake for 40 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack.

items.symptom: Cake is sinking in the middle.
items.cause: Underbaked or oven door opened too early.
items.fix: Add 5 more minutes and test again with a skewer.

items.symptom: Flaked almonds are burning on top.
items.cause: Oven too hot or cake on a high shelf.
items.fix: Lay foil loosely over the tin after 25 minutes.

items.symptom: Cake is very dense and heavy.
items.cause: Butter was not beaten enough with the honey.
items.fix: Beat for a full 3 minutes until the mixture is pale and doubled.
